resources.string: A walking notebook · open-weight Gemma on your phone
Blur mode ON — tap the photo
No EXIF (typical for screenshots or photos saved from chat apps)
The street map needs a connection — tiles are fetched as you look at them. The offline grid always works and reveals exactly the same cells. Nothing about your walk is ever uploaded.
Could not load the street map — showing the offline grid instead.
Nothing on the map yet — that is normal. Go to the map tab and press “Start recording”, then walk: each ~44 m cell you pass through lifts out of the fog.
Grey fog = not walked yet. Walked cells show the street. Green dot = a saved note.\nDrawn on this phone, never uploaded.
Walk with recording on and the fog lifts, one ~44 m cell at a time.
No position yet — use “Use GPS now” on the Note tab.
Delete all saved records on this phone?
Changing this also changes the draft language requested from the model.
Delete the 2.59 GB model file from this phone?
Auto — try GPU, fall back to CPU
Most phones do not expose OpenCL to apps, so the GPU backend fails with “Can not find OpenCL library on this device”. CPU always works and is the default.
Verifying that the model can actually generate …
The street map is not available on this device — showing the offline grid.
The photo, the coordinates, the draft and your walked grid stay in this app\'s own folder. The only network use is the one-time model download.
Model loaded on the GPU. Ready.
Model loaded on the CPU (fallback). Ready.

Done on device — no server was contacted.
Photo processed and archived on this phone.

Description = what is there · Impression = how it felt · Note = time, place, what to look up later.

Checking that this build can really read a photo …
Take or pick a photo first — the note is written from it.
Keywords (text-only models need these): e.g. old iron gate, peeling paint

Delete every note, photo, walked cell and model file stored by this app?
A walk is in progress. Tap to return to the map.
Show a persistent notification while a walk is recording
On by default, so recording continues when you leave the app. Turn it off and recording only runs while WalkNotes is open.
Uninstalling the app removes the models too: they live in the app\'s own storage, never in Downloads or any shared folder.
Export notes, photos and walked cells as a zip to copy to another phone. Model files are not included (re-download them).
Imported %1$d photos. Notes and walked cells restored.
Save the photo with this note
On by default. A short tip appears at the top of the map now and then — rules, a joke, or a nudge to walk. Tap × to dismiss. Turn this off to stop them.

string-array.item: Grey fog = not walked yet. Green dot = a note you saved.
Tap a green dot to read it. Nearby notes share one pin — swipe between them.
Walk a bit more. Every ~44 m lifts another cell out of the fog.
The map looks shy until you walk it. That is the whole trick.
GPS says you are here. The fog says prove it.
One more street. The fog hates that.
Your notes stay on this phone. The street tiles are only a backdrop.
Lost? Recentre. The fog still only shows where you actually walked.

Pick a day, month, year, or everything. Tap a row to play it on the map. Video shares only the path you walked — nothing is uploaded by us.
No saved walks yet. Record a walk, then stop — the path is stored for replay.
Making the video on this phone…
Keywords or a short line — e.g. old iron gate, peeling paint. Text-only models write from this. Vision models use it as extra context.
Look at the photo when writing
This box is the output — the model writes here. You can edit it before saving. It is not the input.
Load a model in Settings first. Gemma 4 E2B can look at the photo. The smaller models cannot — they only read the keywords you type.
This model can see the photo. Tick “Look at the photo” and it writes from the picture + your keywords + time/place. Untick it and it only uses your keywords.
This model loaded as text-only (the photo check failed: %1$s). Type keywords. It will not look at the picture.
This model cannot see photos. Type what is there in the keywords box (objects, colours, materials). Time and place are added automatically. The big box below is the output, not the input.
This model cannot see the photo. Type a few keywords above first, or switch on “Look at the photo” with Gemma 4 E2B.
Loaded on %1$s as text-only. Photo check failed: %2$s
hf_… read token (stays on this phone)
Gemma 4 E2B downloads without a token. Gemma 3 1B and 270M are gated: accept the Gemma licence on huggingface.co while logged in, create a Read token, paste it here. Never send the token in chat.
Hugging Face blocked the file (Gemma licence). Accept the licence in a browser, put a Read token in Settings, then retry. Gemma 4 E2B does not need a token.
File not found on Hugging Face (HTTP 404).
Download size mismatch: got %1$d bytes, expected %2$d. Deleted the bad file.
